<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/reference.mjs. Edit scripts/api.config.mjs, then run "npm run reference" in docs/. -->

Each method name links to Google's reference for it. The same information is in your editor: hover a method to see its description, its quota cost and an example.

- **Quota** is the cost of one call in units. Three methods draw from a bucket of their own instead: see [Quota](/basics/quota/).
- **Auth** is `key` when an API key is enough for public data, `OAuth` when the method always needs a user. A `key` method still needs OAuth for private data or with parameters such as `mine`.

## YouTube Data API v3

82 methods, live streaming included.

### abuseReports

| Method | What it does | Quota | Auth |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `yt.abuseReports.insert` | Files an abuse report about a channel or another entity. | 50 | OAuth |

## Live streaming

These methods are part of the Data API and share its quota.

### liveBroadcasts

Guide: [broadcasts](/live/broadcasts/).

| Method | What it does | Quota | Auth |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`yt.liveBroadcasts.list`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/live/docs/liveBroadcasts/list) | Lists your broadcasts, by status or by id. | 1 | OAuth |
| [`yt.liveBroadcasts.insert`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/live/docs/liveBroadcasts/insert) | Schedules a broadcast. | 1 | OAuth |
| [`yt.liveBroadcasts.update`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/live/docs/liveBroadcasts/update) | Updates a broadcast's title, schedule, privacy or settings. | 1 | OAuth |
| [`yt.liveBroadcasts.bind`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/live/docs/liveBroadcasts/bind) | Attaches a broadcast to a stream, or detaches it when `streamId` is left out. | 1 | OAuth |
| [`yt.liveBroadcasts.delete`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/live/docs/liveBroadcasts/delete) | Deletes a broadcast. | 1 | OAuth |
| [`yt.liveBroadcasts.insertCuepoint`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/live/docs/liveBroadcasts/cuepoint) | Inserts an ad break into a live broadcast. | 1 | OAuth |
| [`yt.liveBroadcasts.transition`](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/live/docs/liveBroadcasts/transition) | Moves a broadcast to `testing`, `live` or `complete`. | 1 | OAuth |
